prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 56-72 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a squat, hunched, menacing young deep-sea psychic horror with a humanoid body: a large bulbous ridged head like an octopus mantle with deep shadows, in darker sea green and near-black slate; two narrow slanted eyes glowing bright yellow-orange with black slit pupils, each a large bright spot, under a heavy brow ridge, the eyes the only light colour on the whole body; the head turned three-quarters toward the viewer so the whole face is seen; exactly six long thick tentacles hanging from the lower face in place of a mouth, fanned wide apart like spread fingers with clear gaps of background between them, each tentacle ending in its own curled tip, all six tips separately visible; mottled dark sea-green and slate-blue skin; crusted dark grey-green shell plates on the shoulders and forearms; a bare ribbed chest; two long arms ending in three-fingered webbed claws held close in front of the body; short bent legs on webbed feet; centred in its own cell with empty space on both sides; palette of dark sea green, near-black slate, dark grey-green and a bright yellow-orange eye glow. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: the bulbous head with two narrow slanted bright yellow-orange eyes under a heavy brow ridge, each a large bright spot, and six spread face tentacles is readable at small size.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, a low lunge toward the heroes: the whole body leaning far forward and down, the head pushed out ahead of the body, the six face tentacles fanned wide open toward the heroes with clear gaps between them, both clawed hands reaching forward but pulled in close below the tentacles (not stretched to the cell edge), the narrow slanted yellow-orange eyes blazing under the heavy brow; exactly six tentacles as in the idle cell; clearly a different pose from the idle, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, the head thrown back, the six face tentacles spread apart and curling up, the clawed hands thrown up close to the head, the narrow yellow-orange eyes still glowing, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a clear diagonal line of action through the whole body, shift the weight onto one leg and lean the torso toward the heroes with the elbows bent, so both clawed hands and all six face tentacles stay well inside its own cell. Draw only the parts named in the description, the same in every cell: no robe, cloth or extra limbs, and no smear, glow trails or motion lines. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on two feet, both feet on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a robe, a cloak, a collar, a staff, a weapon, a fish head, a lure, fins, a mouth, a third eye, violet, purple, lilac, pink, magenta, five tentacles, seven tentacles, round eyes, pale eyes, white eyes, big cute eyes, pastel colours, pale or cream shell plates, yellow spots.
